blocker_description: GRN EX0-5' splice site A>G coordinates not uniquely mapped to GRCh38 from held abstract
resolution_evidence: Ensembl MANE Select ENST00000053867.8 (NM_002087.4) Exon 1 (ENSE00002971866.1, EI0083, chr17:44345302-44345334, c.-40 to c.-8) is the non-coding 5'-UTR exon historically numbered Exon 0 (EX0) in FTLD/ALS literature because translation initiates in Exon 2 (c.1 at chr17:44349165). Its 5' donor splice window (c.-8+1 to c.-8+8, chr17:44345335-44345342, SW0309+SW0310) contains ClinVar Likely Pathogenic variant NM_002087.4(GRN):c.-8+3A>G (ClinVar ID 546798, rs63751020, chr17:44345337A>G) and Pathogenic variant c.-8+5G>C (ClinVar ID 98119, chr17:44345339G>C). Both EI0083 and SW0309/SW0310 are 100% contained within GRN_audit_1 (chr17:44345301-44345342 0-based half-open) in sequence_audit_union_v1.0.bed.

blocker_description: Formal equivalence between historical exon numbering and current MANE exon rank across 8 abstract-only sources (E146-E153)
resolution_evidence: Materiality review confirms that sequence_audit_union_v1.0.bed includes ALL annotated MANE Select exons (including 5'/3' UTRs) plus all core2 (-2..+2) and extended3to8 (-8..-3, +3..+8) splice windows across every exon of all 18 sequence-audited required genes (263 intervals, 77,971 bp; identical between v0.14 and v1.0), plus explicit deep-intronic/hotspot intervals (SOD1 c.358-10T>G at GRCh38 chr21:31668461 [0-based 31668460-31668461, ClinVar 14770, rs1197141604, SOD1_audit_6] and supplemental raw VCF audit of chr21:31667239-31667260 covering c.239+33 at chr21:31667247; KIF5A exon 27 chr12:57582592-57582682). Consequently, historical exon-numbering shifts in legacy abstracts (E146-E153) have zero effect on the genomic coordinate union used for WGS donor screening, and remain qualified in registries/claim_audit.csv (CA006-CA007) for narrative citations.

blocker_description: Unversioned transcript/coding coordinates in abstract-only sources (E154-E157)
resolution_evidence: All genomic screening intervals are anchored to versioned Ensembl/RefSeq MANE Select v1.3 transcripts on GRCh38 (SOD1 ENST00000270142.11 / NM_000454.5 for c.358-10T>G at chr21:31668461 [0-based 31668460-31668461, ClinVar 14770, rs1197141604, SOD1_audit_6]; GRN ENST00000053867.8 / NM_002087.4 for c.-8+3A>G at chr17:44345337; KIF5A ENST00000286452.11 / NM_004984.4 for exon 27 chr12:57582592-57582682; SPTLC2 ENST00000216484.3 / NM_004863.4). Unversioned abstract labels remain qualified in claim_audit.csv and are never used for coordinate lookup without MANE resolution.
